findings.explanation: implementation expects a vendor advisory lookup, but the SPL has none; compliance in the title rests on an arbitrary regex and on version variance, which flags any staged rollout (implementation vs spl).
findings.suggested_fix: Add a lookup of approved/minimum firmware per model, or retitle as firmware version inventory and drift.

findings.explanation: Data is polled weekly but the SPL searches only the last day (`earliest=-1d`), so most days return nothing.
findings.suggested_fix: Match the search window to the poll interval (for example last 8 days) and schedule accordingly.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: After `stats values(fw) as firmware ... by vendor model`, the field `fw` no longer exists, so `match(fw, ...)` is always null and the outdated-version test never fires; only the fw_variants>1 branch works.
Regex `2018|v1\.0` is an arbitrary proxy for outdated firmware and matches build dates and versions such as v1.05; `vendor` is never derived.

summary: The outdated-firmware branch references a field that no longer exists after stats, so it never fires, and 'Compliance' is claimed without any baseline or advisory list.
